dn2:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati jīvakassa komārabhaccassa ambavane mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhateḷasehi bhikkhusatehi.
dn2:1.3: tena kho pana samayena rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto tadahuposathe paṇṇarase komudiyā cātumāsiniyā puṇṇāya puṇṇamāya rattiyā rājāmaccaparivuto uparipāsādavaragato nisinno hoti.
dn2:1.4: atha kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto tadahuposathe udānaṃ udānesi:
dn2:1.5: “ramaṇīyā vata bho dosinā ratti, abhirūpā vata bho dosinā ratti, dassanīyā vata bho dosinā ratti, pāsādikā vata bho dosinā ratti, lakkhaññā vata bho dosinā ratti.
dn2:1.6: kannu khvajja samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā payirupāseyyāma yanno payirupāsato cittaṃ pasīdeyyā!”ti.
dn2:2.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro rājāmacco rājānaṃ māgadhaṃ ajātasattuṃ vedehiputtaṃ etadavoca:
dn2:2.2: ‘ayaṃ deva pūraṇo kassapo saṅghī ceva gaṇī ca gaṇācariyo ca ñāto yasassī titthaṃkaro sādhusammato bahujanassa rattaññū cirapabbajito addhagato vayo anuppatto.
dn2:2.4: appevanāma devassa pūraṇaṃ kassapaṃ payirupāsato cittaṃ pasīdeyyā’ti.
dn2:2.5: evaṃ vutte rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto tuṇhī ahosi.
dn2:3.1: aññataro’pi kho rājāmacco rājānaṃ māgadhaṃ ajātasattuṃ vedehiputtaṃ etadavoca:
dn2:3.2: ‘ayaṃ deva makkhalī gosālo saṅghī ceva gaṇī ca gaṇācariyo ca ñāto yasassī titthaṃkaro sādhusammato bahujanassa rattaññū cirapabbajito addhagato vayoanuppatto.
dn2:3.4: appevanāma devassa makkhaliṃ gosālaṃ payirupāsato cittaṃ pasīdeyyā’ti.
dn2:3.5: evaṃ vutte rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto tuṇhī ahosi.
dn2:4.1: aññataro’pi kho rājāmacco rājānaṃ māgadhaṃ ajātasattuṃ vedehiputtaṃ etadavoca:
dn2:4.2: ‘ayaṃ deva ajito kesakambalo saṅghī ceva gaṇī ca gaṇācariyo ca ñāto yasassī titthaṃkaro sādhusammato bahujanassa rattaññū cirapabbajito addhagato vayo anuppatto.
dn2:4.4: appevanāma devassa ajitaṃ kesakambalaṃ payirupāsato cittaṃ pasīdeyyā’ti.
dn2:4.5: evaṃ vutte rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto tuṇhī ahosi.
dn2:5.1: aññataro’pi kho rājāmacco rājānaṃ māgadhaṃ ajātasattuṃ vedehiputtaṃ etadavoca:
dn2:5.2: ‘ayaṃ deva pakudho kaccāyano saṅghī ceva gaṇī ca gaṇācariyo ca ñāto yasassī titthaṃkaro sādhusammato bahujanassa rattaññū cirapabbajito addhagato vayo anuppatto.
dn2:5.4: appevanāma devassa pakudhaṃ kaccāyanaṃ payirupāsato cittaṃ pasīdeyyā’ti.
dn2:5.5: evaṃ vutte rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto tuṇhī ahosi.
dn2:6.1: aññataro’pi kho rājāmacco rājānaṃ māgadhaṃ ajātasattuṃ vedehiputtaṃ etadavoca:
dn2:6.2: ‘ayaṃ deva sañjayo beḷaṭṭhaputto saṅghī ceva gaṇī ca gaṇācariyo ca ñāto yasassī titthaṃkaro sādhusammato bahujanassa rattaññū cirapabbajito addhagato vayo anuppatto.
dn2:6.4: appevanāma devassa sañjayaṃ beḷaṭṭhaputtaṃ payirupāsato cittaṃ pasīdeyyā’ti.
dn2:6.5: evaṃ vutte rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto tuṇhī ahosi.
dn2:7.1: aññataro’pi kho rājāmacco rājānaṃ māgadhaṃ ajātasattuṃ vedehiputtaṃ etadavoca:
dn2:7.2: ‘ayaṃ deva nigaṇṭho nātaputto saṅghī ceva gaṇī ca gaṇācariyo ca ñāto yasassī titthaṃkaro sādhusammato bahujanassa rattaññū cirapabbajito addhagato vayo anuppatto.
dn2:7.4: appevanāma devassa nigaṇṭhaṃ nātaputtaṃ payirupāsato cittaṃ pasīdeyyā’ti.
dn2:7.5: evaṃ vutte rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto tuṇhī ahosi.
dn2:8.1: tena kho pana samayena jīvako komārabhacco rañño māgadhassa ajātasattussa vedehiputtassa avidūre tuṇhībhūto nisinno hoti.
dn2:8.2: atha kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto jīvakaṃ komārabhaccaṃ etadavoca:
dn2:8.4: “ayaṃ deva, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho amhākaṃ ambavane viharati mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhateḷasehi bhikkhusatehi.
dn2:8.5: taṃ kho pana bhagavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
dn2:8.6: ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti.
dn2:8.8: appevanāma devassa bhagavantaṃ payirupāsato cittaṃ pasīdeyyā”ti.
dn2:9.1: ‘evaṃ devā’ti kho jīvako komārabhacco rañño māgadhassa ajātasattussa vedehiputtassa paṭissutvā pañcamattāni hatthinikāsatāni kappāpetvā rañño ca ārohaṇīyaṃ nāgaṃ, rañño māgadhassa ajātasattussa vedehiputtassa paṭivedesi:
dn2:10.1: atha kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto pañcasu hatthinikāsatesu paccekā itthiyo āropetvā ārohaṇīyaṃ nāgaṃ abhirūhitvā ukkāsu dhāriyamānāsu rājagahamhā niyyāsi mahacca rājānubhāvena. yena jīvakassa komārabhaccassa ambavanaṃ tena pāyāsi.
dn2:10.2: atha kho rañño māgadhassa ajātasattussa vedehiputtassa avidūre ambavanassa ahudeva bhayaṃ ahu chambhitattaṃ ahu lomahaṃso.
dn2:10.3: atha kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto bhīto saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto jīvakaṃ komārabhaccaṃ etadavoca:
dn2:10.5: kacci maṃ samma jīvaka na palambhesi?
dn2:10.6: kacci maṃ samma jīvaka na paccatthikānaṃ desi?
dn2:10.7: kathaṃ hi nāma tāvamahato bhikkhusaṅghassa aḍḍhateḷasānaṃ bhikkhusatānaṃ neva khipitasaddo bhavissati na ukkāsitasaddo na nigghoso?’ti.
dn2:10.12: abhikkama mahārāja, abhikkama mahārāja. ete maṇḍalamāḷe dīpā jhāyantī”ti.
dn2:11.1: atha kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto yāvatikā nāgassa bhūmi nāgena gantvā nāgā paccorohitvā pattiko’va yena maṇḍalamāḷassa dvāraṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā jīvakaṃ komārabhaccaṃ etadavoca:
dn2:11.4: eso mahārāja bhagavā majjhimaṃ thambhaṃ nissāya puratthābhimukho nisinno purakkhato bhikkhusaṅghassā”ti.
dn2:12.1: atha kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
dn2:12.2: ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto tuṇhībhūtaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ anuviloketvā rahadamiva vippasannaṃ, udānaṃ udānesi:
dn2:12.3: ‘iminā me upasamena udāyibhaddo kumāro samannāgato hotu yenetarahi upasamena bhikkhusaṅgho samannāgato’ti.
dn2:12.6: iminā me bhante, upasamena udāyibhaddo kumāro samannāgato hotu yenetarahi upasamena bhikkhusaṅgho samannāgato”ti.
dn2:13.1: atha kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā bhikkhusaṅghassa añjalimpaṇāmetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
dn2:13.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn2:13.4: sace me bhagavā okāsaṃ karoti pañhassa veyyākaraṇāyā”ti.
dn2:14.2: seyyathīdaṃ: hatthārohā assārohā rathikā dhanuggahā celakā calakā piṇḍadāyakā uggā rājaputtā pakkhandino mahānāgā sūrā cammayodhino dāsakaputtā
dn2:14.3: āḷārikā kappakā nahāpakā sūdā mālākārā rajakā pesakārā naḷakārā kumbhakārā gaṇakā muddikā, yāni vā panaññāni’pi evaṃgatikāni puthusippāyatanāni, te diṭṭheva dhamme sandiṭṭhikaṃ sippaphalaṃ upajīvanti.
dn2:14.4: te tena attānaṃ sukhenti pīnenti. mātāpitaro sukhenti pīnenti. puttadāraṃ sukhenti pīnenti. mittāmacce sukhenti pīnenti. samaṇesu brāhmaṇesu uddhaggikaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ patiṭṭhāpenti sovaggikaṃ sukhavipākaṃ saggasaṃvattanikaṃ.
dn2:14.5: sakkā nu kho bhante evameva diṭṭheva dhamme sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ paññāpetunti”.
dn2:15.1: “abhijānāsi no tvaṃ mahārāja, imaṃ pañhaṃ aññe samaṇabrāhmaṇe pucchitā”ti.
dn2:15.2: “abhijānāmahaṃ bhante, imaṃ pañhaṃ aññe samaṇabrāhmaṇe pucchitā”ti.
dn2:15.3: “yathākathaṃ pana te mahārāja byākariṃsu, sace te agaru bhāsassū”ti.
dn2:15.4: “na kho me bhante, garu yatthassa bhagavā vā nisinno bhagavantarūpo vā”ti.
dn2:16.1: “ekamidāhaṃ bhante, samayaṃ yena pūraṇo kassapo tenupasaṅkamiṃ. upasaṅkamitvā pūraṇena kassapena saddhiṃ sammodiṃ.
dn2:16.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃ. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho ahaṃ bhante, pūraṇaṃ kassapaṃ etadavocaṃ:
dn2:16.3: yathā nu kho imāni bho kassapa, puthusippāyatanāni
dn2:16.4: seyyathidaṃ: hatthārohā …pe… yāni vā panaññāni’pi evaṃgatikāni puthusippāyatanāni. te diṭṭheva dhamme sandiṭṭhikaṃ sippaphalaṃ upajīvanti.
dn2:16.5: te tena attānaṃ sukhenti pīnenti mātāpitaro sukhenti pīnenti puttadāraṃ sukhenti pīnenti mittāmacce sukhenti pīnenti samaṇesu brāhmaṇesu uddhaggikaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ patiṭṭhāpenti sovaggikaṃ sukhavipākaṃ saggasaṃvattanikaṃ.
dn2:16.6: sakkā nu kho bho kassapa, evameva diṭṭheva dhamme sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ paññāpetunti.
dn2:17.1: evaṃ vutte bhante, pūraṇo kassapo maṃ etadavoca:
dn2:17.2: karoto kho mahārāja kārayato chindato chedāpayato pacato pācayato socayato socāpayato kilamayato kilamāpayato phandayato phandāpayato pāṇamatipātayato adinnaṃ ādiyato sandhiṃ chindato nillopaṃ harato ekāgārikaṃ karoto paripanthe tiṭṭhato paradāraṃ gacchato musā bhaṇato karoto na karīyati pāpaṃ. khurapariyantena ce’pi cakkena yo imissā paṭhaviyā pāṇe ekamaṃsakhalaṃ ekamaṃsapuñjaṃ kareyya, natthi tatonidānaṃ pāpaṃ, natthipāpassa āgamo.
dn2:17.3: dakkhiṇañce’pi gaṅgāya tīraṃ gaccheyya hananto ghātento chindanto chedāpento pacanto pācento, natthi tato nidānaṃ pāpaṃ, natthi pāpassa āgamo.
dn2:17.4: uttarañce’pi gaṅgāya tīraṃ gaccheyya dadanto dāpento yajanto yajāpento, natthi tato nidānaṃ puññaṃ, natthi puññassa āgamo.
dn2:17.5: dānena damena saṃyamena saccavajjena natthi puññaṃ natthi puññassa āgamo’ti.
dn2:18.1: itthaṃ kho me bhante, pūraṇo kassapo sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ puṭṭho samāno akiriyaṃ byākāsi.
dn2:18.2: seyyathāpi bhante, ambaṃ vā puṭṭho labujaṃ byākareyya labujaṃ vā puṭṭho ambaṃ byākareyya,
dn2:18.3: evameva kho me bhante, pūraṇo kassapo sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ puṭṭho samāno akiriyaṃ byākāsi.
dn2:18.5: ‘kathaṃ hi nāma mādiso samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā vijite vasantaṃ apasādetabbaṃ maññeyyā’ti.
dn2:18.6: so kho ahaṃ bhante, pūraṇassa kassapassa bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandiṃ nappaṭikkosiṃ.
dn2:18.7: anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā anattamano anattamanavācaṃ anicchāretvā tameva vācaṃ anuggaṇhanto anikujjanto uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmiṃ.
dn2:19.1: ekamidāhaṃ bhante, samayaṃ yena makkhali gosālo tenupasaṅkamiṃ. upasaṅkamitvā makkhalinā gosālena saddhiṃ sammodiṃ.
dn2:19.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃ. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho ahaṃ bhante, makkhaliṃ gosālaṃ etadavocaṃ:
dn2:19.3: ‘yathā nu kho imāni bho gosāla puthusippāyatanāni seyyathīdaṃ: hatthārohā …pe…
dn2:19.4: sakkā nu kho bho gosāla, evameva diṭṭheva dhamme sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ paññāpetunti.
dn2:20.1: evaṃ vutte bhante, makkhalī gosālo maṃ etadavoca:
dn2:20.2: ‘natthi mahārāja hetu natthi paccayo sattānaṃ saṃkilesāya. ahetu apaccayā sattā saṃkilissanti.
dn2:20.3: natthi hetu natthi paccayo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā.
dn2:20.5: natthi attakāre natthi parakāre natthi purisakāre natthi balaṃ natthi viriyaṃ natthi purisathāmo natthi purisaparakkamo.
dn2:20.6: sabbe sattā sabbe pāṇā sabbe bhūtā sabbe jīvā avasā abalā aviriyā niyatisaṅgatibhāvapariṇatā chassevābhijātisu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti.
dn2:20.7: cuddasa kho panimāni yonippamukhasatasahassāni saṭṭhi ca satāni cha ca satāni, pañca ca kammuno satāni, pañca ca kammāni, tīṇi ca kammāni, kamme ca aḍḍhakamme ca. dvaṭṭhi paṭipadā, dvaṭṭhantarakappo, chaḷabhijātiyo, aṭṭha purisabhūmiyo ekūnapaññāsa ājīvakasate, ekūnapaññāsa paribbājakasate, ekūnapaññāsa nāgāvāsasate, vīse indriyasate, tiṃsa nirayasate, chattiṃsa rajodhātuyo, satta saññīgabbhā, satta asaññīgabbhā, satta nigaṇṭhigabbhā, satta devā, satta mānusā, satta pesācā, satta sarā, satta pavuṭā, satta pavuṭasatāni, satta papātā, satta papātasatāni, satta supinā, satta supinasatāni, cūḷāsīti mahākappuno satasahassāni yāni bāle ca paṇḍite ca sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhassantaṃ karissanti.
dn2:20.8: tattha natthi imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā aparipakkaṃ vā kammaṃ paripācessāmīti paripakkaṃ vā kammaṃ phussa phussa byantī karissāmīti hevaṃ natthi.
dn2:20.9: doṇamite sukhadukkhe pariyantakate. saṃsāre natthi hāyanavaḍḍhane, natthi ukkaṃsāvakaṃse.
dn2:20.10: seyyathāpi nāma suttaguḷe khitte nibbeṭhiyamānameva paḷeti,
dn2:20.11: evameva bāle ca paṇḍite ca sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhassantaṃ karissantīti.
dn2:21.1: itthaṃ kho me bhante, makkhalī gosālo sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ puṭṭho samāno saṃsārasuddhiṃ byākāsi.
dn2:21.2: seyyathāpi bhante ambaṃ vā puṭṭho labujaṃ byākareyya, labujaṃ vā puṭṭho ambaṃ byākareyya,
dn2:21.3: evameva kho me bhante, makkhalī gosālo sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ puṭṭho samāno saṃsārasuddhiṃ byākāsi.
dn2:21.5: kathaṃ hi nāma mādiso samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā vijite vasantaṃ apasādetabbaṃ maññeyyāti.
dn2:21.6: so kho ahaṃ bhante, makkhalissa gosālassa bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandiṃ nappaṭikkosiṃ.
dn2:21.7: anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā anattamano anattamanavācaṃ anicchāretvā tameva vācaṃ anuggaṇhanto anikujjanto uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamiṃ.
dn2:22.1: ekamidāhaṃ bhante, samayaṃ yena ajito kesakambalo tenupasaṅkamiṃ. upasaṅkamitvā ajitena kesakambalena saddhiṃ sammodiṃ.
dn2:22.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃ. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho ahaṃ bhante, ajitaṃ kesakambalaṃ etadavocaṃ:
dn2:22.3: ‘yathā nu kho imāni bho ajita puthusippāyatanāni seyyathīdaṃ hatthārohā …pe…
dn2:22.4: sakkā nu kho bho ajita evameva diṭṭheva dhamme sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ paññāpetunti?’.
dn2:23.1: evaṃ vutte bhante, ajito kesakambalo maṃ etadavoca:
dn2:23.2: “natthi mahārāja dinnaṃ. natthi yiṭṭhaṃ. natthi hutaṃ. natthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko. natthi ayaṃ loko. natthi paro loko. natthi mātā. natthi pitā. natthi sattā opapātikā. natthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedenti.
dn2:23.3: cātummahābhūtiko ayaṃ puriso yadā kālaṃ karoti, paṭhavī paṭhavīkāyaṃ anupeti anupagacchati. āpo āpokāyaṃ anupeti anupagacchati. tejo tejokāyaṃ anupeti anupagacchati. vāyo vāyokāyaṃ anupeti anupagacchati. ākāsaṃ indriyāni saṅkamanti.
dn2:23.8: tesaṃ tucchaṃ musā vilāpo ye keci atthikavādaṃ vadanti.
dn2:23.9: bāle ca paṇḍite ca kāyassa bhedā ucchijjanti vinassanti na honti parammaraṇā”ti.
dn2:24.1: itthaṃ kho me bhante, ajito kesakambalo sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ puṭṭho samāno ucchedaṃ byākāsi.
dn2:24.2: seyyathāpi bhante, ambaṃ vā puṭṭho labujaṃ byākareyya, labujaṃ vā puṭṭho ambaṃ byākareyya,
dn2:24.3: evameva kho bhante, ajito kesakambalo sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ puṭṭho samāno ucchedaṃ byākāsi.
dn2:24.5: ‘kathaṃ hi nāma mādiso samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā vijite vasantaṃ apasādetabbaṃ maññeyyā’ti.
dn2:24.6: so kho ahaṃ bhante, ajitassa kesakambalassa bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandiṃ nappaṭikkosiṃ.

dn2:40.2: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.
dn2:40.3: so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
dn2:41.1: taṃ dhammaṃ suṇāti gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aññatarasmiṃ vā kule paccājāto.
dn2:41.2: so taṃ dhammaṃ sutvā tathāgate saddhaṃ paṭilabhati.
dn2:41.3: so tena saddhāpaṭilābhena samannāgato iti paṭisañcikkhati:
dn2:41.5: nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṃkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ.
dn2:41.6: yannūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyya’nti.

dn2:42.1: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī. samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu kāyakammavacīkammena samannāgato kusalena. parisuddhājīvo sīlasampanno indriyesu guttadvāro bhojane mattaññū satisampajaññena samannāgato santuṭṭho.
dn2:43.2: idha mahārāja, bhikkhu pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī dayāpanno. sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharati.
dn2:43.4: adinnādānaṃ pahāya adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti dinnādāyī dinnapāṭikaṅkhī. athenena sucibhūtena attanā viharati.
dn2:43.6: abrahmacariyaṃ pahāya brahmacārī hoti ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā.
dn2:44.1: musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭivirato hoti saccavādī saccasandho theto paccayiko avisaṃvādako lokassa.
dn2:44.3: pisuṇaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti. ito sutvā na amutra akkhātā imesaṃ bhedāya. amutra vā sutvā na imesaṃ akkhātā amūsaṃ bhedāya. iti bhinnānaṃ vā sandhātā, sahitānaṃ vā anuppadātā samaggārāmo samaggarato samagganandiṃ samaggakaraṇiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
dn2:44.5: pharusaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti. yā sā vācā neḷā kaṇṇasukhā pemanīyā hadayaṅgamā porī bahujanakantā bahujanamanāpā, tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
dn2:44.7: samphappalāpaṃ pahāya samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti kālavādī bhūtavādī atthavādī dhammavādī vinayavādī. nidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ atthasañhitaṃ.

dn2:59.2: seyyathīdaṃ: candaggāho bhavissati. suriyaggāho bhavissati. nakkhattaggāho bhavissati. candimasuriyānaṃ pathagamanaṃ bhavissati. candimasuriyānaṃ uppathagamanaṃ bhavissati. nakkhattānaṃ pathagamanaṃ bhavissati. nakkhattānaṃ uppathagamanaṃ bhavissati. ukkāpāto bhavissati. disāḍāho bhavissati. bhūmicālo bhavissati. devadundubhi bhavissati. candimasuriyanakkhattānaṃ uggamanaṃ ogamanaṃ saṃkilesaṃ vodānaṃ bhavissati. evaṃvipāko candaggāho bhavissati. evaṃvipāko suriyaggāho bhavissati. evaṃvipāko nakkhattaggāho bhavissati. evaṃvipākaṃ candimasuriyānaṃ pathagamanaṃ bhavissati. evaṃvipākaṃ candimasuriyānaṃ uppathagamanaṃ bhavissati. evaṃvipākaṃ nakkhattānaṃ pathagamanaṃ bhavissati. evaṃvipākaṃ nakkhattānaṃ uppathagamanaṃ bhavissati. evaṃvipāko ukkāpāto bhavissati. evaṃvipāko disāḍāho bhavissati. evaṃvipāko bhūmicālo bhavissati. evaṃvipāko devadundubhi bhavissati. evaṃvipākaṃ candimasuriyanakkhattānaṃ uggamanaṃ ogamanaṃ saṅkilesaṃ vodānaṃ bhavissati.

dn2:63.1: sa kho so mahārāja, bhikkhu evaṃ sīlasampanno na kutoci bhayaṃ samanupassati yadidaṃ sīlasaṃvarato.
dn2:63.2: seyyathāpi mahārāja, khattiyo muddhāvasitto nihatapaccāmitto na kutoci bhayaṃ samanupassati yadidaṃ paccatthikato,
dn2:63.3: evameva kho mahārāja, bhikkhu evaṃ sīlasampanno na kutoci bhayaṃ samanupassati yadidaṃ sīlasaṃvarato.
dn2:63.4: so iminā ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ anavajjasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
dn2:63.5: evaṃ kho mahārāja, bhikkhu sīlasampanno hoti.
dn2:64.1: kathañca mahārāja, bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro hoti?
dn2:64.2: idha mahārāja, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī.
dn2:64.3: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati. rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ. cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
dn2:64.8: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī.
dn2:64.9: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati manindriyaṃ. manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
dn2:64.10: so iminā ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ abyāsekasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
dn2:64.11: evaṃ kho mahārāja, bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro hoti.
dn2:65.1: kathañca mahārāja, bhikkhu satisampajaññena samannāgato hoti?
dn2:65.2: idha mahārāja, bhikkhu abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī hoti. ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī hoti. samiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī hoti. saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī hoti. asite pīte khāyite sāyite sampajānakārī hoti. uccārapassāvakamme sampajānakārī hoti. gate ṭhite nisinne sutte jāgarite bhāsite tuṇhībhāve sampajānakārī hoti.
dn2:65.3: evaṃ kho mahārāja, bhikkhu satisampajaññena samannāgato hoti.
dn2:66.2: idha mahārāja, bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti kāyaparihāriyena cīvarena kucchiparihāriyena piṇḍapātena. so yena yeneva pakkamati samādāyeva pakkamati.
dn2:66.3: seyyathāpi mahārāja, pakkhī sakuṇo yena yeneva ḍeti sapattabhāro’va ḍeti,
dn2:66.4: evameva kho mahārāja, bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti kāyaparihāriyena cīvarena kucchiparihāriyena piṇḍapātena. so yena yeneva pakkamati samādāyeva pakkamati.
dn2:66.5: evaṃ kho mahārāja, bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti.
dn2:67.1: so iminā ca ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato iminā ca ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato iminā ca ariyena satisampajaññena samannāgato imāya ca ariyāya santuṭṭhiyā samannāgato
dn2:67.2: vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ.
dn2:67.3: so pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
dn2:68.1: so abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigatābhijjhena cetasā viharati. abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
dn2:68.2: byāpādapadosaṃ pahāya abyāpannacitto viharati sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī. byāpādapadosā cittaṃ parisodheti.
dn2:68.3: thinamiddhaṃ pahāya vigatathinamiddho viharati ālokasaññī sato sampajāno. thinamiddhā cittaṃ parisodheti.
dn2:68.4: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahāya anuddhato viharati ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto. uddhaccakukkuccā cittaṃ parisodheti.
dn2:68.5: vicikicchaṃ pahāya tiṇṇavicikiccho viharati akathaṃkathī kusalesu dhammesu. vicikicchāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
dn2:69.1: seyyathāpi mahārāja, puriso iṇaṃ ādāya kammante payojeyya,
dn2:69.3: so yāni ca porāṇāni iṇamūlāni tāni ca byantīkareyya, siyā cassa uttariṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ dārabharaṇāya,
dn2:69.5: “ahaṃ kho pubbe iṇaṃ ādāya kammante payojesiṃ.
dn2:69.7: so haṃ yāni ca porāṇāni iṇamūlāni tāni ca byantī akāsiṃ. atthi ca me uttariṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ dārabharaṇāyā”ti.
dn2:69.8: so tatonidānaṃ labhetha pāmojjaṃ, adhigaccheyya somanassaṃ-
dn2:70.1: seyyathāpi mahārāja, puriso ābādhiko assa dukkhito bāḷhagilāno, bhattaṃ cassa nacchādeyya, na cassa kāye balamattā,
dn2:70.2: so aparena samayena tamhā ābādhā mucceyya, bhattañcassa chādeyya, siyā cassa kāye balamattā,
dn2:70.4: “ahaṃ kho pubbe ābādhiko ahosiṃ dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
dn2:70.5: bhattaṃ ca me nacchādesi. nacassa me āsi kāye balamattā.
dn2:70.7: bhattañca me chādeti. atthi ca me kāye balamattā”ti.
dn2:70.8: so tatonidānaṃ labhetha pāmojjaṃ, adhigaccheyya somanassaṃ-
dn2:71.1: seyyathāpi mahārāja, puriso bandhanāgāre baddho assa,
dn2:71.2: so aparena samayena tamhā bandhanāgārā mucceyya sotthinā abbayena, na cassa kiñci bhogānaṃ vayo,
dn2:71.4: “ahaṃ kho pubbe bandhanāgāre baddho ahosiṃ. so’mhi etarahi tamhā bandhanāgārā mutto sotthinā abbayena.
dn2:71.5: natthi ca me kiñci bhogānaṃ vayo”ti.
dn2:71.6: so tatonidānaṃ labhetha pāmojjaṃ, adhigaccheyya somanassaṃ-
dn2:72.1: seyyathāpi mahārāja, puriso dāso assa anattādhīno parādhīno na yenakāmaṅgamo,
dn2:72.2: so aparena samayena tamhā dāsabyā mucceyya attādhīno aparādhīno bhujisso yenakāmaṅgamo,
dn2:72.4: “ahaṃ kho pubbe dāso ahosiṃ anattādhīno parādhīno na yenakāmaṅgamo,
dn2:72.5: so’mhi etarahi tamhā dāsabyā mutto attādhīno aparādhīno bhujisso yenakāmaṅgamo”ti.
dn2:72.6: so tatonidānaṃ labhetha pāmojjaṃ, adhigaccheyya somanassaṃ-
dn2:73.1: seyyathāpi mahārāja, puriso sadhano sabhogo kantāraddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya dubbhikkhaṃ sappaṭibhayaṃ.
dn2:73.2: so aparena samayena taṃ kantāraṃ nitthareyya, sotthinā gāmantaṃ anupāpuṇeyya khemaṃ appaṭibhayaṃ,
dn2:73.4: “ahaṃ kho pubbe sadhano sabhogo kantāraddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjiṃ dubbhikkhaṃ sappaṭibhayaṃ.
dn2:73.5: so’mhi etarahi taṃ kantāraṃ tiṇṇo sotthinā gāmantaṃ anuppatto khemaṃ appaṭibhaya”nti.
dn2:73.6: so tato nidānaṃ labhetha pāmojjaṃ, adhigaccheyya somanassaṃ-
dn2:74.1: evameva kho mahārāja, bhikkhu yathā iṇaṃ yathā rogaṃ yathā bandhanāgāraṃ yathā dāsabyaṃ yathā kantāraddhānamaggaṃ evaṃ ime pañca nīvaraṇe appahīṇe attani samanupassati.
dn2:74.2: seyyathāpi mahārāja ānaṇyaṃ yathā ārogyaṃ yathā bandhanā mokkhaṃ yathā bhujissaṃ yathā khemantabhūmiṃ
dn2:74.3: evameva kho mahārāja, bhikkhu ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahīṇe attani samanupassati.
dn2:74.4: tassime pañca nīvaraṇe pahīṇe attani samanupassato pāmojjaṃ jāyati. pamuditassa pīti jāyati. pītimanassa kāyo passambhati. passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedeti. sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
dn2:75.1: so vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn2:75.2: so imameva kāyaṃ vivekajena pītisukhena abhisanneti parisanneti paripūreti parippharati. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
dn2:76.1: seyyathāpi mahārāja, dakkho nhāpako vā nhāpakantevāsī vā kaṃsathāle nhānīyacuṇṇāni ākiritvā udakena paripphosakaṃ paripphosakaṃ sanneyya sāyaṃ nhānīyapiṇḍi snehānugatā snehaparetā santarabāhirā phuṭā snehena na ca paggharaṇī-
dn2:76.2: evameva kho mahārāja, bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ vivekajena pītisukhena abhisanneti parisanneti paripūreti parippharati. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
dn2:76.3: idampi kho mahārāja, sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ purimehi sandiṭṭhikehi sāmaññaphalehi abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
dn2:77.1: puna caparaṃ mahārāja, bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn2:77.2: so imameva kāyaṃ samādhijena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa samādhijena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
dn2:78.1: seyyathāpi mahārāja, udakarahado gambhīro ubbhidodako, tassa nevassa puratthimāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ, na dakkhiṇāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ, na pacchimāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ, na uttarāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ, devo ca na kālena kālaṃ sammā dhāraṃ anupaveccheyya.
dn2:78.2: atha kho tamhā ca udakarahadā sītā vāridhārā ubbhijjitvā tameva udakarahadaṃ sītena vārinā abhisandeyya parisandeyya paripūreyya paripphareyya, nāssa kiñci sabbāvato udakarahadassa vārinā sītena apphuṭaṃ assa–
dn2:78.3: evameva kho mahārāja, bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ samādhijena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa samādhijena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
dn2:78.4: idampi kho mahārāja, sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ purimehi sandiṭṭhikehi sāmaññaphalehi abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
dn2:79.1: puna caparaṃ mahārāja, bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati sato sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti. yantaṃ ariyā ācikkhanti: upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn2:79.2: so imameva kāyaṃ nippītikena sukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati, nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa nippītikena sukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
dn2:80.1: seyyathāpi mahārāja, uppaliniyaṃ vā paduminiyaṃ vā puṇḍarīkiniyaṃ vā appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaddhāni udakānuggatāni antonimuggaposīni tāni yāva caggā yāva ca mūlā sītena vārinā abhisannāni parisannāni paripūrāni paripphuṭāni nāssā kiñci sabbāvataṃ uppalānaṃ vā padumānaṃ vā puṇḍarīkānaṃ vā sītena vārinā apphuṭaṃ assa.
dn2:80.2: evameva kho mahārāja, bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ nippītikena sukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa nippītikena sukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
dn2:80.3: idampi kho mahārāja, sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ purimehi sandiṭṭhikehi sāmaññaphalehi abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
dn2:81.1: puna caparaṃ mahārāja, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
dn2:81.2: so imameva kāyaṃ parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena pharitvā nisinno hoti. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
dn2:82.1: seyyathāpi mahārāja, puriso odātena vatthena sasīsaṃ pārupitvā nisinno assa, nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa odātena vatthena apphuṭaṃ assa,
dn2:82.2: evameva kho mahārāja, bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena pharitvā nisinno hoti. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
dn2:82.3: idampi kho mahārāja, sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ purimehi sandiṭṭhikehi sāmaññaphalehi abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca. puna caparaṃ
dn2:83.1: so bhikkhu evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte ñāṇadassanāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.
dn2:83.3: “ayaṃ kho me kāyo rūpī cātummahābhūtiko mātāpettikasambhavo odanakummāsūpacayo aniccucchādanaparimaddanabhedanaviddhaṃsanadhammo.
dn2:83.4: idaṃ ca pana me viññāṇaṃ ettha sitaṃ ettha paṭibaddha”nti.
dn2:84.1: seyyathāpi mahārāja, maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭhaṃso suparikammakato accho vippasanno anāvilo sabbākārasampanno,
dn2:84.2: tatra’ssa suttaṃ āvutaṃ nīlaṃ vā pītaṃ vā lohitaṃ vā odātaṃ vā paṇḍusuttaṃ vā.
dn2:84.3: tamenaṃ cakkhumā puriso hatthe karitvā paccavekkheyya
dn2:84.4: “ayaṃ kho maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭhaṃso suparikammakato, accho vippasanno anāvilo sabbākārasampanno.
dn2:84.5: tatridaṃ suttaṃ āvutaṃ nīlaṃ vā pītaṃ vā lohitaṃ vā odātaṃ vā paṇḍusuttaṃ vā”ti.
dn2:84.6: evameva kho mahārāja, bhikkhu evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte ñāṇadassanāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.
dn2:84.8: ayaṃ kho me kāyo rūpī cātummahābhūtiko mātāpettikasambhavo odanakummāsūpacayo aniccucchādanaparimaddanabhedanaviddhaṃsanadhammo.
dn2:84.9: idaṃ ca pana me viññāṇaṃ ettha sitaṃ ettha paṭibaddhanti.
dn2:84.10: idampi kho mahārāja, sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ purimehi sandiṭṭhikehi sāmaññaphalehi abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
dn2:85.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte manomayaṃ kāyaṃ abhinimminanāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.
dn2:85.2: so imamhā kāyā aññaṃ kāyaṃ abhinimmināti rūpiṃ manomayaṃ sabbaṅgapaccaṅgiṃ ahīnindriyaṃ,
dn2:86.1: seyyathāpi mahārāja, puriso muñjamhā isikaṃ pavāheyya.
dn2:86.3: ayaṃ muñjo ayaṃ isikā añño muñjo aññā isikā muñjamhātveva isikā pavāḷhāti.
dn2:86.4: seyyathāpi vā pana mahārāja, puriso asiṃ kosiyā pavāheyya.
dn2:86.6: “ayaṃ asi ayaṃ kosi, añño asi aññā kosi, kosiyātveva asi pavāḷho”ti.
dn2:86.7: seyyathāpi vā pana mahārāja, puriso ahiṃ karaṇḍā uddhareyya.
dn2:86.9: “ayaṃ ahi ayaṃ karaṇḍo. añño ahi añño karaṇḍo, karaṇḍātveva ahi ubbhato”ti.
dn2:86.10: evameva kho mahārāja, bhikkhu evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte manomayaṃ kāyaṃ abhinimminanāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.
dn2:86.11: so imamhā kāyā aññaṃ kāyaṃ abhinimmināti rūpiṃ manomayaṃ sabbaṅgapaccaṅgiṃ ahīnindriyaṃ.
dn2:86.12: idampi kho mahārāja, sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ purimehi sandiṭṭhikehi sāmaññaphalehi abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
dn2:87.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte iddhividhāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.
dn2:87.2: so anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti: eko’pi hutvā bahudhā hoti bahudhāpi hutvā eko hoti, āvībhāvaṃ tirobhāvaṃ tirokuḍḍaṃ tiropākāraṃ tiropabbataṃ asajjamāno gacchati seyyathāpi ākāse, paṭhaviyā’pi ummujjanimujjaṃ karoti seyyathāpi udake. udake’pi abhijjamāne gacchati seyyathāpi paṭhaviyaṃ. ākāse’pi pallaṅkena kamati seyyathā’pi pakkhī sakuṇo. ime’pi candimasuriye evaṃmahiddhike evaṃmahānubhāve pāṇinā parāmasati parimajjati. yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti.
dn2:88.1: seyyathāpi mahārāja, dakkho kumbhakāro vā kumbhakārantevāsī vā suparikammakatāya mattikāya yaṃ yadeva bhājanavikatiṃ ākaṅkheyya taṃ tadeva kareyya abhinipphādeyya-
dn2:88.2: seyyathāpi vā pana mahārāja, dakkho dantakāro vā dantakārantevāsī vā suparikammakatasmiṃ dantasmiṃ yaṃ yadeva dantavikatiṃ ākaṅkheyya taṃ tadeva kareyya abhinipphādeyya-
dn2:88.3: seyyathā vā pana mahārāja, dakkho suvaṇṇakāro vā suvaṇṇakārantevāsī vā suparikammakatasmiṃ suvaṇṇasmiṃ yaṃ yadeva suvaṇṇavikatiṃ ākaṅkheyya taṃ tadeva kareyya abhinipphādeyya-
dn2:88.4: evameva kho mahārāja, bhikkhu evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte iddhividhāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.
dn2:88.5: so anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti: eko’pi hutvā bahudhā hoti. bahudhā’pi hutvā eko hoti. āvībhāvaṃ tirobhāvaṃ tirokuḍḍaṃ tiropākāraṃ tiropabbataṃ asajjamāno gacchati seyyathāpi ākāse. paṭhaviyā’pi ummujjanimujjaṃ karoti seyyathāpi udake. udake’pi abhijjamāne gacchati seyyathāpi paṭhaviyaṃ. ākāse’pi pallaṅkena kamati seyyathāpi pakkhī sakuṇo. ime’pi candimasuriye evaṃmahiddhike evaṃmahānubhāve pāṇinā parāmasati parimajjati. yāva brahmalokā’pi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti.
dn2:88.6: idampi kho mahārāja, sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ purimehi sandiṭṭhikehi sāmaññaphalehi abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
dn2:89.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte dibbāya sotadhātuyā cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.
dn2:89.2: so dibbāya sotadhātuyā visuddhāya atikkantamānusikāya ubho sadde suṇāti dibbe ca mānuse ca ye dūre santike ca.
dn2:90.1: seyyathāpi mahārāja, puriso addhānamaggapaṭipanno. so suṇeyya bherisaddampi mudiṅgasaddampi saṅkhapaṇavadeṇḍimasaddampi tassa evamassa: bherisaddo iti’pi mudiṅgasaddo iti’pi saṅkhapaṇavadeṇḍimasaddo iti’pi.
dn2:90.2: evameva kho mahārāja bhikkhu evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte dibbāya sotadhātuyā cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.
dn2:90.3: so dibbāya sotadhātuyā visuddhāya atikkantamānusikāya ubho sadde suṇāti dibbe ca mānuse ca ye dūre santike ca.

dn2:91.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte cetopariyañāṇāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.

dn2:91.10: vikkhittaṃ vā cittaṃ vikkhittaṃ cittanti pajānāti.

dn2:91.14: anuttaraṃ vā cittaṃ anuttaraṃ cittanti pajānāti.

dn2:91.16: asamāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ asamāhitaṃ cittanti pajānāti.
dn2:91.17: vimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ cittanti pajānāti.
dn2:91.18: avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ avimuttaṃ cittanti pajānāti.

dn2:93.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.
dn2:93.2: so anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati seyyathidaṃ: ekampi jātiṃ dve’pi jātiyo tisso’pi jātiyo catasso’pi jātiyo pañca’pi jātiyo dasa’pi jātiyo vīsampi jātiyo tiṃsampi jātiyo cattārīsampi jātiyo paññāsampi jātiyo jātisatampi jātisahassampi jātisatasahassampi aneke’pi saṃvaṭṭakappe aneke’pi vivaṭṭakappe aneke’pi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe amutrāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto. so tato cuto amutra upapādiṃ tatrāpāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto. so tato cuto idhūpapanno’ti. iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
dn2:94.1: seyyathāpi mahārāja, puriso sakamhā gāmā aññaṃ gāmaṃ gaccheyya tamhā’pi gāmā aññaṃ gāmaṃ gaccheyya. so tamhā gāmā sakaññeva gāmaṃ paccāgaccheyya. tassa evamassa: ‘ahaṃ kho sakamhā gāmā amuṃ gāmaṃ agacchiṃ tatrā evaṃ aṭṭhāsiṃ evaṃ nisīdiṃ evaṃ abhāsiṃ evaṃ tuṇhī ahosiṃ. tamhāpi gāmā amuṃ gāmaṃ agacchiṃ tatrāpi evaṃ aṭṭhāsiṃ evaṃ nisīdiṃ evaṃ abhāsiṃ evaṃ tuṇhī ahosiṃ. so’mhi tamhā gāmā sakaññeva gāmaṃ paccāgato’ti.

dn2:95.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte sattānaṃ cutūpapātañāṇāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.
dn2:95.2: so dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāti: ‘ime vata bhonto sattā kāyaduccaritena samannāgatā vacīduccaritena samannāgatā manoduccaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ upavādakā micchādiṭṭhikā micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānā. te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā. ime vā pana bhonto sattā kāyasucaritena samannāgatā vacīsucaritena samannāgatā manosucaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ anupavādakā sammādiṭṭhikā sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānā. te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā’ti. iti dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāti.
dn2:96.1: seyyathāpi mahārāja, majjhe siṃghāṭake pāsādo. tattha cakkhumā puriso ṭhito passeyya manusse gehaṃ pavisante’pi nikkhamantepi rathiyā vīthisañcarante’pi majjhe siṃghāṭake nisinne’pi, tassa evamassa: ete manussā gehaṃ pavisanti. ete nikkhamanti. ete rathiyā vīthisañcaranti. ete majjhe siṅghāṭake nisinnā’ti.
dn2:96.2: evameva kho mahārāja, bhikkhu evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte sattānaṃ cutūpapātañāṇāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.

dn2:97.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti
dn2:97.2: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ dukkhanirodho’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
dn2:97.3: ime āsavā’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ āsavasamudayo’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ āsavanirodho’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ āsavanirodhagāminīpaṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
dn2:97.4: tassa evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati bhavāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati avijjāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati.
dn2:97.6: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
dn2:98.1: seyyathāpi mahārāja, pabbatasaṅkhepe udakarahado accho vippasanno anāvilo. tattha cakkhumā puriso tīre ṭhito passeyya sippisambukampi sakkharakaṭhalampi macchagumbampi carantampi tiṭṭhantampi. tassa evamassa: ayaṃ kho udakarahado accho vippasanno anāvilo. tatrime sippisambukā’pi sakkharakaṭhalā’pi macchagumbā’pi carantipi tiṭṭhantipīti.
dn2:98.2: evameva kho mahārāja, bhikkhu evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.

dn2:98.5: tassa evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavā’pi cittaṃ vimuccati, bhavāsavā’pi cittaṃ vimuccati, avijjāsavā’pi cittaṃ vimuccati.
dn2:98.7: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānāti.
dn2:98.8: idaṃ kho mahārāja, sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ purimehi sandiṭṭhikehi sāmaññaphalehi abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
dn2:98.9: imasmā ca pana mahārāja sandiṭṭhikā sāmaññaphalā aññaṃ sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ uttaritaraṃ vā paṇītataraṃ vā natthīti.
dn2:99.1: evaṃ vutte rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn2:99.3: seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti, evameva bhante bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
dn2:99.4: esāhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi, dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
dn2:99.5: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gataṃ.
dn2:99.6: accayo maṃ bhante accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ yo’haṃ pitaraṃ dhammikaṃ dhammarājānaṃ issariyassa kāraṇā jīvitā voropesiṃ.
dn2:99.7: tassa me bhante bhagavā accayaṃ accayato paṭiggaṇhātu āyatiṃ saṃvarāyā’ti.
dn2:100.1: taggha tvaṃ mahārāja, accayo accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ yo tvaṃ pitaraṃ dhammikaṃ dhammarājānaṃ jīvitā voropesi.
dn2:100.2: yato ca kho tvaṃ mahārāja, accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikarosi. taṃ te mayaṃ paṭigaṇhāma.
dn2:100.3: vuddhi hesā mahārāja, ariyassa vinaye yo accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikaroti āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjatīti.
dn2:101.1: evaṃ vutte rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn2:101.2: handa ca dāni mayaṃ bhante gacchāma bahukiccā mayaṃ bahukaraṇīyā’ti.
dn2:101.4: atha kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
dn2:102.1: atha kho bhagavā acirapakkantassa rañño māgadhassa ajātasattussa vedehiputtassa bhikkhū āmantesi:
dn2:102.4: sacāyaṃ bhikkhave rājā pitaraṃ dhammikaṃ dhammarājānaṃ jīvitā na voropessatha imasmiṃ yeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ uppajjissathāti.
dn2:102.6: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
